description: Get current and historical U.S. savings bond rates — the Series I composite, its fixed and inflation components, and Series EE rates by issue cohort — and optionally how many bonds the public holds and how many are being sold. An I bond's headline rate applies for six months only; the fixed component is the part that lasts.

include.description: Extras. "ee_cohorts" groups EE bonds by the rate rules of their issue window; "sales" is TreasuryDirect volume, which spikes when the I bond rate is high.

name: get_savings_bond_rates
title: Get savings bond rates
